# Fine Art America

> > Fine Art America is the world's largest online art marketplace and print-on-demand platform connecting independent artists with buyers seeking wall art, home decor, and custom lifestyle products.

The platform enables artists to sell original artwork and prints while keeping 100% of profits, and offers museum-quality custom printing services with archival inks for products ranging from canvas prints to yoga mats. Featured artists include Eric Fan, Jennifer Lommers, Johan Swanepoel, and partnerships with iconic brands like Sports Illustrated and Getty Images.

## Key Topics

- Print-on-demand manufacturing
- Artist marketplace and community
- Wall art (canvas, metal, framed prints)
- Custom printing and photo upload
- Home decor products
- Archival inks and museum-quality
- Independent artist designs
- Product customization
- Online art marketplace
- Lifestyle products (blankets, pillows, shower curtains)
- Money-back guarantee
- Eric Fan, Jennifer Lommers, Johan Swanepoel (featured artists)
- Sports Illustrated, Getty Images (brand partnerships)
- Membership plans for artists

## Getting Started

- [Sell Art Online in 2026 - Join the World's Largest Art Site](https://fineartamerica.com/sell-art-online): Artist platform to sell original art and prints, keep 100% profits
- [Shop Incredibly Unique Designs by Independent Artists and Iconic Brands](https://fineartamerica.com/shop): Main shop page for art prints, home decor, and products from artists worldwide
- [Membership Plans](https://fineartamerica.com/membershipplans.html): Compare free and premium membership plans for artists and sellers
- [Fine Art America Reviews](https://fineartamerica.com/reviews): Customer testimonials and buyer reviews from verified purchasers

## Wall Art & Prints

- [Wall Art You'll Love in 2026](https://fineartamerica.com/wall-art): Curated wall art marketplace: prints, canvas, metal, posters, tapestries
- [Canvas Art Prints You'll Love](https://fineartamerica.com/shop/canvas+prints): Museum-quality canvas prints from artists or upload custom photos
- [Drawings for Sale](https://fineartamerica.com/art/drawings): Browse pen, ink, pencil, and colored drawings from global artists
- [Custom Framed Prints](https://fineartamerica.com/custom/create-custom-framed-prints): Upload photos for museum-quality custom framed prints with archival inks
- [Custom Prints](https://fineartamerica.com/custom/create-custom-prints): Print-on-demand custom prints with archival inks, ships worldwide in 3-4 days
- [Custom Wood Prints](https://fineartamerica.com/custom/create-custom-wood-prints): Upload photos for custom maple wood prints with archival inks

## Home Decor & Lifestyle Products

- [Art Inspired Lifestyle Products](https://fineartamerica.com/lifestyle): Shop tote bags, phone cases, and artist-designed lifestyle products
- [Throw Pillows](https://fineartamerica.com/shop/throw+pillows): 100% cotton decorative pillows handcrafted in North Carolina with artist designs
- [Fleece Blankets](https://fineartamerica.com/shop/fleece+blankets): Custom fleece and sherpa blankets featuring artist designs, ships in 2-3 days
- [Shower Curtains](https://fineartamerica.com/shop/shower+curtains): Unique shower curtains by independent artists, custom manufactured in 2-3 days
- [Greeting Cards](https://fineartamerica.com/shop/greeting+cards): 5x7 custom greeting cards with artist designs and personalized messages

## Custom Product Creation

- [Custom Yoga Mats](https://fineartamerica.com/custom/create-custom-yoga-mats): Upload photos to create custom eco-friendly PVC yoga mats with carrying bag
- [Custom Shower Curtains](https://fineartamerica.com/custom/create-custom-shower-curtains): Polyester custom shower curtains from uploaded photos, made in Hendersonville NC
- [Custom Greeting Cards](https://fineartamerica.com/custom/create-custom-greeting-cards): Create personalized greeting cards from uploaded photos, ships in 2-3 days
